walkthroughs.body_html:
Metals, polymers and ceramics each have different properties.

Composites combine the best of both - e.g. carbon fibre + resin.

Fossil fuels: high energy, but CO2.

Hydrogen: clean burn, hard to store.

Biofuels: renewable, land use issues.

CO2, CH4 and water vapour trap infrared.

Causes global warming and climate change.

mcqs.q: At room temperature and pressure, what volume does 1 mole of any gas occupy?
options: Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.
Approximately 24 dm^3 (24,000 cm^3), regardless of the identity of the gas.
Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
Heavier gases occupy a smaller volume per mole because their particles are denser.

mcqs.q: What is reduction in terms of electrons?
options: Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.
Heterogeneous catalysts are consumed; homogeneous catalysts are not.
Reduction means losing oxygen and oxidation means gaining oxygen — full stop.
Gain of electrons (the oxidation number is reduced).

mcqs.q: What distinguishes a heterogeneous from a homogeneous catalyst?
options: Heterogeneous catalysts are consumed; homogeneous catalysts are not.
Reduction means a substance becomes physically smaller in size.
A heterogeneous catalyst is in a different phase from the reactants; a homogeneous catalyst is in the same phase.
Heterogeneous catalysts are solid and homogeneous catalysts are liquid — full stop.
